compensate.note: plan B's _compensate under CPython's f64, the triple fresh per case; Pa, abs 0.05 (a thirtieth of the 1.6 Pa RMS noise, ~4 mm)

compensate_f32.note: plan B's expression evaluated in single precision op by op, as MicroPython on the P4 does (proven to be plan B's expression: unrounded it equals plan B's own call bit for bit); Pa, exact

cases.name: present
cases.output: id 0x08 ok -- device present; setup failed AFTER detect (init / config / timing)

cases.name: zeros
cases.output: id reads 0x00 -- chip-select not asserting, or device unpowered

cases.name: another_part
cases.output: id reads 0x09, expected 0x08 -- wrong device on this bus/select (crosswired)

cases.name: the_command_naks
cases.output: no bus response -- device not acking (absent / unpowered / miswired)

cases.name: the_read_naks
cases.output: no bus response -- device not acking (absent / unpowered / miswired)

diagnose.note: diagnose(): the id command, the masked word; the verdict text

measure.note: _measure(): the command, the 12 ms conversion, the frame; altitude m, temperature degrees C, pressure Pa (the triple fresh), or the refusal of a frame failing a CRC; pressure abs 0.05, temperature exact, altitude abs 0.005

run.note: run() after a clean setup on the virtual clock: input the stamped transcript (at_ms) and the end; output the readings (at_ms, altitude, temperature, pressure) and the re-arm moments. The port's poll, ticked every millisecond, must make each transaction at plan B's millisecond. A period passes between setup and the run, so _read()'s sample cache (not ported) serves nothing. Pressure abs 0.05, temperature exact, altitude abs 0.005, times exact

divergence.note: a general call went out and plan B re-armed no peer, because its setup then failed; the port reports the general call (take_general_call) whatever setup answers

setup.note: setup() over a scripted part: the transcript; output ok, the ground zero (m) and whether plan B re-armed the peers; a case with a divergence owes its output instead

output.refused: no fresh altitude to re-zero from

divergence.note: float()'s own error text is the interpreter's ("could not convert string to float: 'high'" here); the port refuses in its own words

output.refused: could not convert string to float: 'high'

update.note: update() from a ground of 7.0 m: the changed properties and the ground, or the refusal text and the ground left as it was; a case with a divergence owes its output instead
